confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from five web searches of secondary sources (cost-of-living aggregators including Expatistan-derived figures, and travel guides). These quote SEK prices that disagree and are sometimes dated or Sweden-wide. I converted at about 9.7 SEK/USD, inferred from those pages' own conversions rather than a separately sourced rate. Beer (~SEK 75), coffee (~SEK 45) and inexpensive meal (~SEK 130) are best supported. Mid-range meal for two (~SEK 900; sources span about 600-1,000) is least certain. Cocktail (~SEK 150) and wine glass (~SEK 105) use travel-guide ranges and a local relationship to beer (about 2.0x and 1.4x), not current menus. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not search accommodation prices or check live listings, and July event demand can lift rates. The FX figure was taken from a search result reporting the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Gothenburg-specific aggregator and travel-guide figures. From general knowledge, Gothenburg sits slightly below Stockholm and well below Copenhagen and Oslo. Accommodation is anchored to mid-sized Nordic city levels with mixed business and leisure demand.
